video.decoding_capability: Live view up to 16 channels of VGA, 4 channels of 720p, or 2 channels of 1080p via HDMI or VGA output

features: Recording: up to 24 channels of 720p (RAID 0 and 7,200rpm HDD) or 16 channels (RAID 1 or 5,400rpm HDD), or half the channel density using 1080p (datasheet); user manual specification table states 24 cameras 720p or 12 cameras 1080p, while the manual feature list states 14 cameras 1080p
Up to 16TB internal storage with encryption (4 HDDs, not included); additional storage via external eSATA
Power consumption 4.274 W without HDD (idle); 14.67 W with 2 HDDs and 22.67 W with 4 HDDs recording; max 65.994 W with 4 HDDs in boot mode (technical bulletin, HW V1.4A)
Video compression: H.264 baseline, main or high profile; audio G.711 (u-Law and a-Law), synchronized audio and video recording
Recording modes: continuous, schedule, event triggered or manual
Motion detection with up to 16 motion detection target areas; intelligent search by time & date and motion
Supports Grandstream GXV36xx cameras, GXV35xx encoders/decoders and third-party ONVIF compliant cameras; ONVIF 2.2
Alarm inputs: datasheet states 4 inputs (NO/NC), user manual states 16 inputs (sources conflict); 2 relay alarm outputs
1x RCA line-in, 1x RCA line-out, 2x USB 2.0, UPS management, IR remote control
Package weight 4052.5 g (unit weight not stated)
